defects.evidence: proposal run_controls: baseline_status is recorded but unused as a gate; results append detected=(status=='counterexample') and all_detected=bool(results) and len(det)==len(results); discriminating is reported separately and never required for all_detected. Reference boundary_controls._call raises on positive-baseline rejection before counting mutation detection.
defects.reason: all_detected is computed solely from observed status=='counterexample' and does not require a clean non-counterexample baseline; an inspector that always returns counterexample can satisfy all_detected while discriminating stays 0, so the suite cannot ensure mutations fail only for the correct relation.

defects.evidence: proposal post_state() tries dict keys ('post','state','after','next','new_state','post_state','to','result') or len-2 tuples; m_event_decoupled returns 'retained event schema unrecognized' on miss. Obligation findings: 'Unbound event schema — o14-setup-delivery-control-build.py ev()/states() … Bind the retained-event schema explicitly.' Limitations admit batch-07 t.trace_event/t.restore unsupplied.
defects.reason: Retained adapter event post-state encoding remains a multi-key / len-2 heuristic; the obligation packet required an explicit bind, and without batch-07 the event-poststate control’s discrimination is still unproven.

defects.evidence: Obligation findings Vacuous frame / Corruption masked on implement SETUP ~L35-37 and _frame gated semantics; proposal CONTROLS list has no append-schedule/frame witness; docstring only says not_applicable/unproved never count as detection. Packet: 'run_controls' inspect_cases would flag implement via F1, but the proposal never exercises that interop.
defects.reason: Interop with the vacuous o14 SETUP frame (append:success:1/2/3 vs domain 0/1/2) is only implicit via not counting not-applicable as detection; the proposal never mutates or asserts setup append literals and does not declare all_detected=False as the expected outcome against the current implement.

defects.evidence: CONTROLS final entry tier 'plumbing' / m_hash_only; det and all_detected aggregate all results without excluding tier!='semantic'; only semantic_detected is separate. Docstring: "'outer-hash-only' is plumbing: hash rejection alone is not semantic discrimination."
defects.reason: Plumbing control outer-hash-only is included in all_detected / detected totals, contradicting the module’s claim that hash rejection alone is not semantic discrimination and risking gate misread of suite success.

defects.evidence: proposal pay() then inspect_cases([copy.deepcopy(case)], charge) and again after mutation; no limits dict or durable plan. Reference run_controls builds durable_plan, LocalControlCounter(limits), and Counter(reservation) per retained call.
defects.reason: Shared charge object is locally take(1)’d then passed into inspect_cases with no declared reservation plan or separation of runner vs auditor counters; accounting honesty relative to the reference durable_precharge/LocalControlCounter pattern is unverifiable and possibly double-charged.

defects.evidence: proposal dig/js recurse with only depth>8 truncation; run_controls accepts arbitrary cases. Reference MAX_INPUT/MAX_JSON/MAX_GZIP and require() bounds throughout.
defects.reason: No explicit input cardinality / depth bounds on cases, rows, events, or JSON digests, unlike the reference MAX_* gates; adversarial oversized retained cases are not refused up front.

defects.evidence: proposal docstring: "'unproved' and 'not_applicable'"; obligation findings quote verdict 'not-applicable'.
defects.reason: Status vocabulary in the docstring uses not_applicable (underscore) while obligation findings cite not-applicable (hyphen); detection ignores that token but consumers correlating baseline_status strings may mismatch.

defects.evidence: CONTROLS witness string for pair-event-index-lie; m_pair_event_lie returns None when not pairs; docstring: attestation refused in both subclasses so pair controls needing an existing pair expected to report missing witnesses.
defects.reason: pair-event-index-lie is self-described as unreachable while attestation is refused domain-wide, so a named semantic control is expected to degrade to missing-witness rather than discrimination.

required_checks: Gate all_detected (or a lead-facing pass predicate) on clean baseline_status not in {'counterexample','inspector-exception',...} and optionally on discriminating for every semantic control that applied.
Exclude plumbing tier from all_detected / require a separate semantic_all_detected that matches the docstring contract.
Bind retained event post-state to the real batch-07 / check.py trace_event schema (or drop event-poststate until bound) and re-review m_event_decoupled against fixture bytes.
Inject the actual o14 inspect_cases (pre- and post- SETUP literal fix) and record whether baseline is not-applicable and whether all_detected is False under the broken frame.
Specify charge reservation accounting: runner precharges vs inspector-internal takes; assert no silent under/overcount vs a declared plan.
Confirm mutation_changed_bytes dig() cannot false-negative on the mutated paths (depth>8 / repr collisions) for each CONTROLS entry.
Reconcile status token spelling with the implement’s actual status strings before correlating limitations.
reservations: Static review only; no code executed; scientific_status BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED; no admission.
batch-07 identity module, p_literal fixtures, and live inspect_cases behavior are unsupplied; case/event/row schemas are inferred from packet citations and proposal claims treated as untrusted.
Append-index / SETUP literal correctness is an implement defect outside this file; controls can only expose it if the broken inspector is the injected callable.
Reference boundary_controls.py is a different layer (inventory/shard/outer-binding/typed certificates); structural parity is partial by design and does not alone validate o14 case-level controls.
Packet dissent on scoring not-applicable remains unresolved policy; this review scores missing positive-baseline gating and unbound event schema as defects regardless.
strengths: Stdlib-only module; no import/execution of reducers, guards, boundary helpers, or scientific models; inspect_cases and charge are injected.
Adds forged-pair-launders-decoupling (m_forged_pair_laundering), directly targeting the packet’s generation-coupling / forged-pair gap.

Detection requires verbatim status 'counterexample'; inspector exceptions and non-counterexample statuses are not counted as detection—appropriate pressure on a vacuous not-applicable frame if that inspector is actually injected.
Absent witnesses become explicit limitations ('no genuinely reachable witness' / error strings), not silent skips; event mutation is schema-guarded to one control.
Charges take(1) before baseline replay, each mutation attempt, and each mutated replay; refused take stops evaluation.
Explicitly refuses scientific PASS/acceptance; labels outer-hash-only as plumbing; origin_acceptance false.
review.summary: Returned o14 controls are self-contained and improve on the packet’s control-build gaps (forged-pair mutation, counterexample-only detection, honest missing-witness paths), but still leave retained-event encoding unbound, omit a positive-baseline gate so all_detected can pass a always-counterexample inspector, and never bind or exercise the vacuous SETUP-frame implement defect that the obligation packet treats as central.
